description:
### Quick Start 1. If you haven't already, first create an API-token on the website. API-tokens can be managed in the settings of your account. Make sure to save your token somewhere secure, as it will not be shown again after creation. 2. Send a POST request to the `/v1/session` endpoint with your API-token. This creates a short-lived session token. Tip: A unique source can help us troubleshoot problems quicker when contacting support. ```json { "accessToken": "API_TOKEN", "source": "Postman" } ``` 3. Include the session token from the response in your request headers to access the rest of the API. ``` Authorization: SESSION_TOKEN ``` ### Filters Various parameters support filters. These can be identified with the format `($filter-type)`, where `type` is a known [OAS type format](https://github.com/OAI/OpenAPI-Specification/blob/master/versions/3.0.0.md#data-types). Currently only one filter can be applied to a parameter.
Strings #### Strings (`$filter-string`)
| Filter | Syntax | Example | |---|---|---| | Equal* | `[eq]` | `?parameter=value` | | Not equal | `[not_eq]` | `?parameter[not_eq]=value` | | Like** | `[like]` | `?parameter[like]=%25value%25` | | Not like** | `[not_like]` | `?parameter[not_like]=%25value%25` |
\* Equal is used as the default filter if none is given.
\*\* Wildcards `?` (one character) and `%` (multiple characters) may be used. Keep in mind these must be escaped when used in a query.
Numbers #### Numbers (`$filter-int32`, `$filter-int64`)
| Filter | Syntax | Example | |---|---|---| | Equal* | `[eq]` | `?parameter=5` | | Not equal | `[not_eq]` | `?parameter[not_eq]=5` | | Greater than | `[gt]` | `?parameter[gt]=5` | | Greater than or equal to | `[gte]` | `?parameter[gte]=5` | | Less than | `[lt]` | `?parameter[lt]=5` | | Less than or equal to | `[lte]` | `?parameter[lte]=5` | | Range** | `[range]` | `?parameter[range]=5,10` |
\* Equal is used as the default filter if none is given. \*\* Values are inclusive.
Dates #### Dates (`$filter-date`)
| Filter | Syntax | Example | |---|---|---| | Equal* | `[eq]` | `?parameter=2025-01-01` | | Not equal | `[not_eq]` | `?parameter[not_eq]=2025-01-01` | | Greater than | `[gt]` | `?parameter[gt]=2025-01-01` | | Greater than or equal to | `[gte]` | `?parameter[gte]=2025-01-01` | | Less than | `[lt]` | `?parameter[lt]=2025-01-01` | | Less than or equal to | `[lte]` | `?parameter[lte]=2025-01-01` | | Range** | `[range]` | `?parameter[range]=2025-01-01,2025-12-31` |
\* Equal is used as the default filter if none is given. \*\* Values are inclusive.
### Paging Most search endpoints have an optional `limit` and `offset` parameter. The parameter `limit` defaults to 100 and must be an integer between 1 and 2000. The parameter `offset` defaults to 0 and must be a positive integer. ### Dates Some endpoints accept or return date properties. These should always follow the ISO 8601 format. The format is `YYYY-MM-DD` for dates. ### VAT codes Some endpoints accept or return VAT codes. Please ensure that you only use VAT codes relevant to the country your company is registered in.
The available VAT codes are as follows.

### Company registration number The company registration number is a unique identifier for a company. In the Netherlands this is the "KVK-nummer". In Belgium this is the "ondernemingsnummer". ### Error Codes Possible error codes thrown by endpoints. If the property `code` is present on an error response, it will contain one of these codes.

tools.name: administration_get
tools.description: Get all administrations managed by the authorized accountant. Optional: limit, offset. Returns array of AdministrationResponseDto.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of items to retrieve.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items to skip.

tools.name: administration_get-linked
tools.description: Get all administrations that are linked to the authorized administration. Please note that this endpoint will always return administrations linked to the administration of the user that created the API credentials. Optional: limit, offset. Returns array of AdministrationResponseDto.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of items to retrieve.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items to skip.

tools.name: costcenter_create-cost-center
tools.description: Create a new cost center. Optional: active, description, parentId. Returns the new CostCenterCreateResponse.

params.name: active
params.description: Whether the cost center is active. Error codes COST_007 Cost center parent is not active.

params.name: description
params.description: The description of the cost center. Error codes COST_003 Cost center description is required. COST_004 Cost center description is too long. COST_005 Cost center with this name already exists on this level of the tree. COST_011 Cost center fullPath is too long. COST_012 Cost center description has invalid characters.

params.name: parentId
params.description: The parent ID of the cost center. Error codes COST_005 Cost center with this name already exists on this level of the tree. COST_006 Cost center parent id cannot be changed. COST_007 Cost center parent is not active. COST_008 Cost center parent not found.

tools.name: costcenter_delete-cost-center
tools.description: Permanently delete a cost center by id. Required: id (the cost center's numeric identifier, in the URL path). Returns 204 No Content on success, 404 if the id doesn't match an existing cost center, or 400 if id is malformed. Irreversible — there is no undo or restore endpoint for cost centers. Destructive.

params.name: id
params.description: Id

tools.description: Get a cost center. Required: id. Returns the CostCenterResponse.

params.name: id
params.description: Id

tools.name: invoice_create
tools.description: Create a new invoice. Required: items, relationId, templateId, termOfPayment (default: 0). Optional: date, directDebit, email (plus 7 more). Returns the new CreatedInvoice.

params.name: date
params.description: Invoice date. Error codes FACT_011 Invoice date is missing. FACT_012 Invoice date invalid. FACT_013 Invoice date out of range.

params.name: directDebit
params.description: If this object is provided, the invoice will be marked for direct debit with the provided details.

params.name: email
params.description: If this object is provided, the invoice will be e-mailed to the relation immediately. Error codes FACT_EMAIL_005 Something went wrong while attaching files to the email.

params.name: emailTemplateId
params.description: The ID of an email template. Error codes FACT_020 Email template not found.

params.name: inExVat
params.description: Indicates if the amount on the invoice is including (`IN`) or excluding (`EX`) VAT. The corresponding value will be calculated based on the VAT code. If left empty the 'EX' option will be used Error codes FACT_010 Invoice VAT must be IN or EX.

params.name: invoiceNumber
params.description: Invoice number. Must end with a number. If empty, we will create a new number. Error codes FACT_006 Invoice number is missing. FACT_007 Invoice number is too long. FACT_008 Invoice number is invalid. FACT_009 Invoice number does not end with a digit. FACT_101 Invoice number is in use.

params.name: items
params.description: At least one invoice item is required. Error codes FACT_004 Total invoice amount too high. FACT_005 Total invoice amount too low. FACT_019 Invoice items are missing. FACT_025 Too many items.

params.name: mutation
params.description: If this object is provided, the invoice will also be processed as a new mutation. Error codes FACT_VERWERK_001 Invoice date resides in a closed period.

params.name: print

tools.name: session_end
tools.description: Revoke the current session token, immediately ending the authenticated session. No parameters. Returns 204 No Content on success or 401 if the session is already invalid. After calling this, the CLI must re-authenticate (exchange the long-lived API token for a new session token) before making further API calls. Destructive.

params.name: source
params.description: Code to identify your integration. Error codes API_SESSION_001 Source is missing. API_SESSION_002 Source does not match pattern.

Use swagger_get with a specific catchAll value to fetch one sub-resource directly.
